# What keeps a plant upright?

<!-- STEP id="questions" -->
## Four questions
Look at the plants around you and think about these questions:

- What keeps a plant upright?
- Why does a fresh twig bend, but a dry twig break?
- Why are seed coats hard?
- How do aquatic plants, such as lotus, float?

<!-- STEP id="supporting" -->
## Supporting tissues
All of these are the work of supporting tissues. There are three of them: parenchyma, collenchyma and sclerenchyma. Each is a simple permanent tissue, made of one type of cell, and each has a different structure.

<!-- STEP id="hook" -->
> **If all three give support, why does a plant have three different kinds?**
